overview: This paper proposes FusedKV and FusedKV-Lite, cross-layer KV cache reconstruction methods that leverage asymmetric key-value sharing (values from bottom layers, keys from middle layers) to reduce KV cache memory by 50% while achieving lower perplexity than standard Transformer decoders across 332M to 4B parameter scales.

modules.name: Transformer Decoder with Cross-Layer KV Cache Framework
modules.description: Implements the overall Transformer decoder architecture partitioned into storage layers and reconstruction layers, including the source layer mapping function that specifies which storage layers supply KV caches for each reconstruction layer, and the parameterized reconstruction function interface.

modules.name: FusedKV Weighted Fusion Reconstruction
modules.description: Implements the FusedKV method where top-half layer KV caches are reconstructed as a learnable dimension-wise weighted fusion (Hadamard product with learnable weight vectors) of caches from the bottom layer and the middle layer, supporting independent key and value fusion weights for each reconstruction layer.

modules.name: FusedKV-Lite Asymmetric Direct Reuse
modules.description: Implements the efficient FusedKV-Lite variant where top-half layer keys are directly reused from the middle layer and values from the bottom layer without any fusion computation, eliminating additional I/O overhead for maximum inference efficiency.

modules.name: RoPE Compatibility with Symmetric Weight Constraint
modules.description: Implements the mathematical guarantee that weighted fusion of post-RoPE keys preserves relative positional encoding by enforcing symmetry within each 2D weight pair (w_{2j} = w_{2j+1}), including the derivation-aware weight parameterization that constrains learnable weights to be 2D-diagonal.

modules.name: Triton-Based FusedKV Attention Kernel
modules.description: Implements the custom Triton kernel for FusedKV attention computation that handles the fused key cache construction during both prefilling and decoding, optimizing cache I/O patterns and fusion computation to balance throughput and latency.

modules.name: Baseline Architecture Implementations
modules.description: Implements baseline methods including Vanilla MHA, GQA (with configurable query-to-KV head ratio), YOCO (cross-layer reuse from intermediate layer), and CLA (interleaved adjacent-layer sharing), all under the same Transformer decoder framework for fair comparison.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Tokenization Pipeline
modules.description: Handles FineWeb-Edu dataset preprocessing including tokenization with 128k vocabulary, sequence packing to 8192 context length, validation split sampling, and batch construction for autoregressive language modeling.

modules.name: Training Loop with Gradient Accumulation and Mixed Precision
modules.description: Implements the complete training workflow including epoch and token-step management, gradient accumulation, mixed-precision training, gradient clipping, and checkpoint saving at regular token intervals for convergence analysis.

modules.name: Optimizer and Learning Rate Scheduling
modules.description: Implements AdamW optimizer with specified betas, weight decay, cosine learning rate schedule with linear warmup, and minimum learning rate, supporting different model scale configurations.

modules.name: FusedKV Initialization Strategies
modules.description: Implements three initialization strategies for FusedKV weights: iterative fusion with auxiliary caches (creating dependency chains across reconstruction layers), normal initialization (independent standard normal sampling), and equivalent initialization (recursively computing weights to match iterative method output at initialization).

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics and Benchmark Suite
modules.description: Implements perplexity evaluation on validation splits and WikiText, plus few-shot evaluation on downstream tasks (MNLI, SCIQ, LAMBADA, Hellaswag, ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, MMLU) using the LM Evaluation Harness, aggregating results into average accuracy.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Implements controlled ablation experiments including directionality of KV asymmetry (reversed vs. proposed assignment), impact of learnable vs. fixed weights, source layer selection for keys and values independently, and comparison of symmetric vs. asymmetric sharing configurations.

modules.name: Inference Efficiency Benchmarking
modules.description: Implements end-to-end inference speed measurement including attention kernel throughput, Time to First Token (TTFT) for prefilling, and Time Per Output Token (TPOT) for decoding under both memory-bound and compute-bound scenarios across varying sequence lengths.

modules.name: Long Context Extension and RULER Evaluation
modules.description: Implements the two-stage context window extension strategy (8k to 32k to 128k with progressive RoPE base scaling) and evaluation on the RULER benchmark for long-range dependency tasks including NIAH, multi-key, multi-query, and QA variants.

modules.name: Architecture Compatibility Integration
modules.description: Implements integration modules for combining FusedKV with other efficiency techniques including MLA (joint KV compression), GQA (grouped-query attention), MoE (mixture-of-experts FFN replacement), sliding window attention (hybrid SWA+full attention patterns), Kivi quantization, and Wanda pruning, with appropriate adaptation of fusion strategies per architecture.

modules.name: Gradient Visualization and Scaling Law Analysis
modules.description: Implements gradient L2 norm tracking for query, key, and value projection matrices across network depths during training, and scaling law analysis comparing validation loss curves across model sizes from 332M to 4B parameters with corresponding token budgets.
